40022102.author: पदार्थः
40022102.content: तथोक्ते when thus spoken, तान् those, ऋषीन् sages, रामः Rama, प्रत्युवाच replied, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, किमाहारः what is his food, किमाचारः what is his conduct, लवणः Lavana, क्व where, च and, वर्तते does he reside.

40022102.author: Translation
40022102.content: When the sages had spoken thus, Rama, with folded hands, replied to them, asking what Lavana's food and conduct were, and where he resided.

40022103.author: पदार्थः
40022103.content: राघवस्य of Rama, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषयः sages, सर्व all, एव indeed, ते those, ततः then, निवेदयामासुः they reported, लवणः Lavana, ववृधे grew, यथा how.

40022103.author: Translation
40022103.content: Having heard Rama's words, all those sages then reported how Lavana had grown in power.

40022104.author: पदार्थः
40022104.content: आहारः his food, सर्वसत्त्वानि all beings, विशेषेण especially, च and, तापसाः ascetics, आचारः his conduct, रौद्रता ferocity, नित्यम् always, वासः his dwelling, मधुवने in Madhuvana, तथा also.

40022104.author: Translation
40022104.content: His food consists of all beings, especially ascetics, his conduct is perpetually ferocious, and his dwelling is in the Madhuvana forest.

40022105.author: पदार्थः
40022105.content: हत्वा having killed, बहुसहस्राणि many thousands, सिंहव्याघ्रमृगद्विपान् lions, tigers, deer, and elephants, मानुषांश्चैव and humans indeed, कुरुते he makes, नित्यमाहारमाह्निकम् a daily meal.

40022105.author: Translation
40022105.content: Having killed many thousands of lions, tigers, deer, elephants, and humans, he makes them his daily meal.

40022106.author: पदार्थः
40022106.content: ततो then, अन्तराणि other, सत्त्वानि beings, खादते he eats, सः that, महाबलः mighty one, संहारे at the time of dissolution, समनुप्राप्ते having arrived, व्यादितास्यः with an open mouth, इव like, अन्तकः Yama.

40022106.author: Translation
40022106.content: Then, that mighty one devours other beings, like Yama with an open mouth at the time of cosmic dissolution.

40022107.author: पदार्थः
40022107.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Rama, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, सः he, महामुनीन् to the great sages, घातयिष्यामि I shall kill, तद्रक्षो that demon, हि indeed, अपगच्छतु let it go away, वः your, भयम् fear.

40022107.author: Translation
40022107.content: Having heard that, Rama spoke these words to the great sages: "I shall indeed kill that demon; let your fear depart."

40022108.author: पदार्थः
40022108.content: प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, तथा thus, तेषां to them, मुनीनाम् to the sages, उग्रतेजसाम् of fierce ascetic power, सः he, भ्रातऽन्सहितान्सर्वान् to all his assembled brothers, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनः Rama.

40022108.author: Translation
40022108.content: Having thus promised those sages of fierce ascetic power, Rama then spoke to all his assembled brothers.

40022109.author: पदार्थः
40022109.content: कः who, हन्ता will kill, लवणम् Lavana, वीरः hero, कस्यांशः whose share, सः that, विधीयताम् let it be assigned, भरतस्य of Bharata, महाबाहोः the mighty-armed, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, च and, धीमतः the intelligent.

40022109.author: Translation
40022109.content: "Which hero will kill Lavana? To whom among the mighty-armed Bharata and the intelligent Shatrughna should that task be assigned?"

40022110.author: पदार्थः
40022110.content: राघवेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तु indeed, भरतः Bharata, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, अहम् I, एनम् him, वधिष्यामि will kill, मम my, अंशः share, सः that, विधीयताम् let it be assigned.

40022110.author: Translation
40022110.content: When Rama thus spoke, Bharata replied, "I will kill him; let that task be assigned to me."

40022111.author: पदार्थः
40022111.content: भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, धैर्यशौर्यसमन्वितम् endowed with courage and valor, लक्ष्मणावरजः Lakshmana's younger brother, तस्थौ stood up, हित्वा having left, सौवर्णम् golden, आसनम् seat.

40022111.author: Translation
40022111.content: Having heard Bharata's words, which were full of courage and valor, Shatrughna, Lakshmana's younger brother, stood up, leaving his golden seat.

40022112.author: पदार्थः
40022112.content: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् spoke, वाक्यम् words, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, नराधिपम् to the king, कृतकर्मा one who has accomplished deeds, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, मध्यमः the middle one, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu dynasty.

40022112.author: Translation
40022112.content: Shatrughna, having bowed down to the king, then spoke, referring to the mighty-armed Bharata, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, as one who has already accomplished great deeds.

40022113.author: पदार्थः
40022113.content: आर्येण by the noble one, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, शून्या desolate, अयोध्या Ayodhya, परिपालिता was protected, सन्तापम् sorrow, हृदये in the heart, कृत्वा having kept, आर्यस्य of the noble one, आगमनम् return, प्रति regarding.

40022113.author: Translation
40022113.content: Indeed, Ayodhya, though desolate, was formerly protected by the noble Bharata, who kept sorrow in his heart regarding the return of the noble Rama.

40022114.author: पदार्थः
40022114.content: दुःखानि sorrows, च and, बहूनि many, इह here, हि indeed, अनुभूतानि experienced, पार्थिव O King, शयानो lying down, दुःखशय्यासु on beds of sorrow, नन्दिग्रामे in Nandigrama, अवसत् resided, पुरा formerly.

40022114.author: Translation
40022114.content: O King, Bharata indeed experienced many sufferings here, formerly residing in Nandigrama, lying on uncomfortable beds.

40022115.author: पदार्थः
40022115.content: फलमूलाशनो one who eats fruits and roots, भूत्वा having become, जटी with matted hair, चीरधरस्तथा and wearing bark garments, अनुभूय having experienced, ईदृशं such, दुःखम् sorrow, एष this, राघवनन्दनः son of Raghu (Bharata), प्रेष्ये while a servant, मयि I (am), स्थिते present, राजन् O King, न not, भूयः again, क्लेशम् trouble, आप्नुयात् should obtain.

40022115.author: Translation
40022115.content: Bharata, having become an ascetic eating fruits and roots, with matted hair and bark garments, and having experienced such sorrow, should not again suffer while I, your servant, am present, O King.

40022116.author: पदार्थः
40022116.content: तथा thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, शत्रुघ्ने by Shatrughna, राघवः Rama, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् spoke, एवम् thus, भवतु let it be, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, क्रियतां let it be done, मम my, शासनम् command.

40022116.author: Translation
40022116.content: While Shatrughna was speaking thus, Rama again said, "So be it, O Kakutstha; let my command be carried out."

40022117.author: पदार्थः
40022117.content: राज्ये in the kingdom, त्वाम् you, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall anoint, मधोः of Madhu, तु indeed, नगरे in the city, शुभे auspicious, निवेशय establish, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, भरतम् Bharata, यदि if, अवेक्षसे you care for.

40022117.author: Translation
40022117.content: I shall install you in the auspicious city of Madhu's kingdom; O mighty-armed one, establish Bharata there if you care for him.

40022118.author: पदार्थः
40022118.content: शूरः brave, त्वम् you, कृतविद्यः learned, च and, समर्थः capable, च and, निवेशने in establishing (a city/kingdom).

40022118.author: Translation
40022118.content: You are brave, learned, and capable in establishing a kingdom.

40022119.author: पदार्थः
40022119.content: यः who, हि indeed, शत्रुम् an enemy, समुत्पाट्य having uprooted, पार्थिवस्य of the king, पुनः again, क्षये in the destruction, न not, विधत्ते establishes, नृपम् a king, तत्र there, नरकम् hell, सः he, हि indeed, गच्छति goes.

40022119.author: Translation
40022119.content: Indeed, whoever uproots an enemy and, in the destruction of that king's domain, does not establish a new ruler there, he certainly goes to hell.

40022120.author: पदार्थः
40022120.content: स one who, त्वं you, हत्वा having killed, मधुसुतं the son of Madhu, लवणं Lavana, पापनिश्चयम् one whose resolve is evil, राज्यं the kingdom, प्रशाधि rule, धर्मेण righteously, वाक्यं the word, मे my, यदि if, अवेक्षसे you regard.

40022120.author: Translation
40022120.content: If you respect my words, then you, having killed Lavana, the evil-minded son of Madhu, should rule the kingdom righteously.

40022121.author: पदार्थः
40022121.content: उत्तरं a reply, च and, न not, वक्तव्यं to be spoken, शूर O hero, वाक्यान्तरे in the midst of my words, मम my, बालेन by a younger one, पूर्वजस्य of an elder brother, आज्ञा the command, कर्तव्या should be done, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.

40022121.author: Translation
40022121.content: O hero, do not speak a reply while I am speaking, for a younger brother must obey the command of an elder, there is no doubt about this.

40022122.author: पदार्थः
40022122.content: अभिषेकं the consecration, च and, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, प्रतीच्छस्व accept, मया by me, उद्यतम् prepared, वसिष्ठप्रमुखैः by Vasistha and other prominent ones, विप्रैः by Brahmins, विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् accompanied by rituals and mantras.

40022122.author: Translation
40022122.content: O Kakutstha, accept this consecration prepared by me, which is performed by prominent Brahmins like Vasistha, accompanied by proper rituals and mantras. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 62।। Thus ends the sixty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
